part.text:
Fixed in `lib/helpers/isAbsoluteURL.js:19`: URLs beginning with `//` are no longer treated as absolute, so they stay path-relative and are combined with `baseURL` instead of being resolved as protocol-relative URLs.

Validation:
- SSRF regression test now passes.
- All unit tests pass except the pre-existing `should support HTTPS protocol` test, which times out reaching `https://www.google.com` (environmental).
- ESLint passes.
